lessons.title: Experiences up to now
objectives: Describe a life experience and connect it to the present.
Develop a connected response in a discussion about experiences up to now with a reason and relevant detail.

content_sections.title: Notice the connected language (10 minutes)
content_sections.body: Read this model: 'I have considered experiences up to now, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.' Identify the main point, the linking expression, and the supporting detail. Then explain how the wording helps the speaker achieve this objective: Describe a life experience and connect it to the present.

content_sections.title: Guided exchange (10 minutes)
content_sections.body: Work with a partner in a discussion about experiences up to now. Give a clear main point, support it with a specific reason, and respond to one follow-up question. Use tactful language when the other speaker presents a different perspective.

content_sections.title: Independent connected response (8 minutes)
content_sections.body: Prepare a one-minute response about experiences up to now. Organize it into thought groups, stress the words that carry your main point, and finish with a concise conclusion rather than a list of isolated sentences.

exercises.prompt: Choose the most connected and tactful response for a discussion about experiences up to now.
options: I have considered experiences up to now, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.
Experiences up to now is a topic, but I will not explain my view.
Several details exist about experiences up to now, perhaps.
exercises.correct_answer: I have considered experiences up to now, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.

exercises.prompt: Complete this response about experiences up to now: 'My experience supports this view ____.'
acceptable_answers: because it offers evidence about experiences up to now

exercises.prompt: Read the short response about experiences up to now and identify how the writer handles another view.
exercises.stimulus: Although another person may disagree about experiences up to now, I can respond politely and explain my reason.

questions.question: How does the writer respond to disagreement?
acceptable_answers: The writer responds politely and gives a reason in the discussion of experiences up to now.

exercises.prompt: Speak for 60–90 seconds in a discussion about experiences up to now. State your point, support it, and answer one follow-up question.

criteria: Presents a connected main point about experiences up to now with relevant support.
Responds clearly and tactfully to a follow-up question about experiences up to now.

listening.instruction: Listen once to a short response about experiences up to now. Identify the view and supporting reason before the transcript is revealed, then listen again to check the linking language.
listening.goal: Follow the main point and support in spoken language about experiences up to now.
listening.transcript: I have considered experiences up to now, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.
listening.question: What view and supporting reason does the speaker communicate?
listening.answer: The speaker connects a considered view about experiences up to now to a useful reason from experience.
constraints: Keep the transcript private before the learner answers the first question.
Use only the supplied transcript; do not require media.

speaking.instruction: Roleplay a discussion about experiences up to now. Learner role: present and support a view. Tutor role: ask one probing question and offer a different perspective. End after the learner responds tactfully and summarizes the point.
speaking.goal: Sustain a connected, tactful exchange about experiences up to now.
constraints: State both roles before beginning the exchange.
Use at most four tutor turns and stop after the learner summary.

pronunciation.instruction: Record the model about experiences up to now in meaningful thought groups. Stress the main point and reason, then compare a second attempt with the first for clarity and rhythm.
pronunciation.goal: Make connected speech about experiences up to now easy to follow.
pronunciation.target: Thought groups and information stress for experiences up to now
constraints: Assess pronunciation only when learner audio is supplied.
Return NOT_ASSESSED when learner audio is unavailable.

writing.instruction: Write 90–120 words about experiences up to now. State a position or experience, support it with a reason and example, and acknowledge another perspective. Submit your own draft before asking for feedback.
writing.goal: Produce a connected written response about experiences up to now.
constraints: Wait for the learner draft before giving feedback.
Give concise feedback only; do not replace the learner draft.
